protocol.target_protocol: five COMSOL trajectories outer-LOO; deterministic validation rotation; N fit groups
protocol.trend_prior: causal linear/quadratic/Huber/Ridge prior fitted on fit_groups only; policy is recorded per run

blend_selection.N>=2: fit-only inner leave-one-outer-fit-group-out OOF; equal-per-group macro RMSE
blend_selection.N=1: chronological outer-validation fallback because inner group-LOO is impossible

validation_affine_calibrated_transfer.adapter: bounded affine map from raw transfer prediction to raw target RUL
validation_affine_calibrated_transfer.selection: identity and bounded affine candidates compared on validation only
validation_affine_calibrated_transfer.reporting: paired only with its validation-affine scratch counterpart; not interchangeable with raw pure transfer

ridge_calibrated_transfer.selection: configured fit-only inner group-LOO OOF for N>=2; chronological validation fallback for N=1; never outer holdout
ridge_calibrated_transfer.target_ridge_fit: fit_groups_only; alpha selected on chronological validation

calibrated_transfer.selection: configured fit-only inner group-LOO OOF for N>=2; chronological validation fallback for N=1; never outer holdout

target_context.definition: first observed target feature vector, repeated causally per window

residual_adaptation.blend_selection: configured fit-only inner group-LOO OOF for N>=2; chronological validation fallback for N=1

protocol.main_transfer: source-residual-pretrained shared encoder plus target projection and residual head; explicit short frozen warmup, low-LR unfreeze and encoder anchor; retained checkpoint is required to be post-unfreeze; residual mixture weights use fit-only inner group-LOO OOF for N>=2 and chronological validation only as the explicit N=1 fallback
protocol.residual_target: normalized target RUL minus selected causal target trend
protocol.source_residual_target: normalized source RUL minus source-train-only causal source trend
protocol.source_sampling: source residual pretraining uses train-only inverse-window-count loss weights so every source trajectory has equal effective loss mass
protocol.frozen_ablation: pretrained shared encoder frozen; target projection and residual head trainable
protocol.scratch: same trend-residual target architecture, data, epoch budget, early stopping and seeds; every transfer hybrid has the same calibration operation applied to scratch

matched_scratch_controls.selection_rule: fixed weights are identical; configured selection uses matched fit-only inner group-LOO OOF grids for N>=2 and the same chronological-validation fallback grids for N=1

protocol.full_life_min_max: never used for target input conversion
protocol.proxy_warning: COMSOL is a reaction-wheel simulation domain, not real flight telemetry

blend_selection.N>=2: fit-only inner leave-one-outer-fit-group-out OOF; equal-per-group macro RMSE
blend_selection.N=1: chronological outer-validation fallback because inner group-LOO is impossible

target_adapter_alignment.target_data: outer fit-group input windows only; inner OOF fits use an inner subset only
